arguments.value: 28-year-old woman with primary Sjögren’s syndrome presented for replacement of missing and severely worn dentition, with xerostomia, xerophthalmia, caries, erosions, and reduced vertical dimension; comprehensive prosthodontic rehabilitation was planned, including extractions, endodontic therapy, post-and-core buildup, crown/bridge fabrication, occlusal increase, and night guard, with good follow-up stability and periodontal health.
